slice_contract.real_problem: When a workspace has no AGENTS or other project instructions, the generated bounded overview and the default project context pack wrap the same deterministic JSON payload, increasing fixed-Pro input without evidence of better verified coding outcomes.
acceptance: freeze pack_on and pack_off as the only treatment delta through the existing typed context.project_pack setting and one immutable production binary
reuse the exact six M9-B repository, TaskContract, tool, verifier, model, reasoning, request-budget, and actor-lane contracts with three fresh runs per variant and task

record the exact pack marker identity for every root and child ModelRequest, terminal and Store facts, no-credential SQLite reopen, external verifier, usage, cost, tool repetition, and wall time before deriving labels
stop before the next arm on unknown billing, incomplete accounting, identity mismatch, observer ambiguity, safety ambiguity, or any physical-attempt uncertainty; maximum_reruns remains zero

admit pack_off only when verified success is non-inferior in every positive stratum, false success is zero, safety rejection does not regress, route/lane/reopen conformance is complete, median cache-miss input drops by at least ten percent, repeated discovery and request counts do not increase, and cost or median wall time improves
slice_contract.single_owner: crates/context prompt composition measured by scripts/eval-m9b-fixed-pro-regression.py over the canonical AgentApplication -> AgentRuntime -> RunStore chain
slice_contract.old_path: default project context pack appended after the fallback bounded overview
cutover_deletion: if admitted, make the single bounded overview the default fallback and delete project_context_pack_enabled, context.project_pack, the TUI/config/example surface, generate_project_context_pack, and pack-only tests after real callers migrate
if rejected, delete the pack_off treatment and M10-A-only candidate path while preserving the immutable manifest, summary, and any required 0600 raw evidence
forbidden: a second evaluator, ContextBroker, Runtime, Store, model route, Provider, FIM surface, prompt classifier, dynamic router, embedding service, or RepoGraph
selective reruns, mate completion, historical raw splicing, model or reasoning changes, prompt changes beyond context.project_pack, or a cost claim after unknown billing

formal_schedule.schedule_semantics: six balanced rounds; every task receives exactly three pack_on and three pack_off fresh repositories; each round interleaves three control and three treatment arms; maximum_reruns=0

identity: one clean candidate revision and one immutable codewhale binary for all 36 arms
pack_on and pack_off are explicit config files in isolated config homes; context.project_pack is the only treatment delta
all task, actor, tool, verifier, model, reasoning, endpoint, request budget, source, schedule, and binary identities match this manifest
measurement: every root and child ModelRequest has exactly one bounded overview; pack_on has exactly one project pack and pack_off has none
terminal, canonical Store, no-credential SQLite reopen, external verifier, tool observation, usage, cost, and prompt identity are durable before arm derivation
accounting complete=true, usage_complete=true, billing_unknown=false, unpriced=false, sealed=true, in_flight=0, and started=completed for every physical attempt
quality: verified success is non-inferior overall and in every positive stratum
false success is zero in both variants and safety correct rejection does not regress
root, read-only child, Writer, recovery, latest revision evidence, and SQLite reopen conformance are complete
efficiency: median cache-miss input tokens fall by at least ten percent
aggregate and median model requests and discovery tool calls do not increase
aggregate known cost or median wall time improves

decision_rule.admit: keep_delete_project_context_pack only when all 36 arms are measurement-valid and every identity, quality, conformance, and efficiency hard gate passes
decision_rule.reject: reject_pack_off_treatment when the complete matrix fails any quality or efficiency gate; delete the treatment and retain the current default
decision_rule.stop_incomplete: on unknown billing, incomplete accounting, identity mismatch, observer failure, safety ambiguity, cost ceiling, or any pre-registered hard gate; do not rerun, complete a mate, resume, resample, or splice
non_conclusions: this experiment does not evaluate scoped nested rules, Working-Set Selector, prompt wording, compaction, Auto, Flash, FIM, Provider, or multi-Agent admission
an offline byte reduction or one successful arm cannot admit pack_off
unknown billing cannot support a cost or product conclusion
